# LibreOffice Writer GUI Interface

## Window Header

- **Application Title Bar**
  - Left: "LibreOffice Writer" icon and text
  - Center: "Untitled 1.docx - LibreOffice Writer"
  - Right: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons

- **System Information Bar**
  - Date and time: "Oct 23 17:19"
  - System tray icons: Bell (notifications), Sound, Power

## Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Items**
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Styles
  - Table
  - Form
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help

## Toolbar

- **Quick Access Toolbar**
  - New Document
  - Open Document
  - Save Document
  - Save As
  - Print
  - Undo
  - Redo
  - Find
  - Spelling and Grammar Check
  - Document Properties

- **Formatting Toolbar**
  - Paragraph Style Dropdown: "Default Paragraph Style"
  - Font Selection: "Liberation Serif"
  - Font Size: "12 pt"
  - Bold (B)
  - Italic (I)
  - Underline (U)
  - Strikethrough (S)
  - Superscript (A°)
  - Subscript (A_)
  - Font Color
  - Highlight Color
  - Text Alignment (Left, Center, Right, Justify)
  - Indentation Controls
  - Bulleted and Numbered Lists
  - Line Spacing
  - Page Break
  - Column Break
  - Table Insertion
  - Special Characters (Ω)
  - Drawing Tools (Pen, Shapes)

## Status Bar

- **Document Information**
  - Page: "Page 1 of 1"
  - Word Count: "0 words, 0 characters"
  - Page Style: "Default Page Style"
  - Language: "English (Hong Kong)"

- **Zoom Control**
  - Zoom Slider
  - Zoom Percentage: "100%"

## Sidebar

- **Vertical Scrollbar**
  - Located on the right side of the document area

- **Sidebar Icons (Visible)**
  - **Formatting Palette** (orange icon with paintbrush)
  - **Styles** (purple icon with document)
  - **Navigation** (blue icon with arrow)
  - **Page Layout** (white icon with page)
  - **Master Document** (gray icon with document)

## Notification Bar

- **Blue Notification Strip**
  - Message 1: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!"
    - Button: "Get involved"
    - Close Button: "X"
  - Message 2: "Your donations support our worldwide community."
    - Button: "Donate"
    - Close Button: "X"

## Document Area

- **Blank Document**
  - White background
  - Text cursor positioned at the top-left corner
  - Document margins visible

## Desktop Environment

- **Left Dock (Application Launcher)**
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer (active)
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Trash

- **Bottom Dock (System Tray)**
  - Activities button (grid icon)
  - System status icons (sound, power)
